purpose: Immutable binding of Wave06 report content to its introducing commit SHA. Two-step protocol per REPAIR F: implementation report ships in one commit recording IMPLEMENTATION_CONTENT_HEAD; this manifest ships in the next commit and records REPORT_COMMIT_HEAD + REPORT_BINDING_HEAD. This resolves the audit finding that a file cannot self-contain the SHA of the commit that first introduces it.

IMPLEMENTATION_CONTENT_HEAD.meaning: HEAD at the moment the report content was authored; documented inside the report body.

REPORT_COMMIT_HEAD.meaning: The commit that introduced the Wave06 handoff and ledger.

REPORT_BINDING_HEAD.meaning: This manifest's own commit SHA — observable by a fresh audit session via `git log`.

how_to_verify.step_1: git rev-parse 808f9de → confirms REPORT_COMMIT_HEAD points to the handoff+ledger commit.
how_to_verify.step_2: git log --oneline 808f9de..HEAD → confirms REPORT_BINDING_HEAD is this manifest's commit (immediate successor of REPORT_COMMIT_HEAD in the intended flow).
how_to_verify.step_3: sha256sum on each bound_artifacts[].path → must match the sha256 field. If any hash diverges the report has been mutated post-binding.
how_to_verify.step_4: cat reports/taaqol_full_integration/QIYAS_TAAQOL_REMEDIATION_02_HANDOFF.md | grep 'IMPLEMENTATION_CONTENT_HEAD\|277ff13' → confirms the report body's self-declared IMPLEMENTATION_CONTENT_HEAD.

audit_verdict_addressed: PARTIALLY_VERIFIED → all six open locally-closeable defects remediated. Awaiting fresh strictly read-only audit session.
